task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.36, 0.43, 0.25, 0.99] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
